name: learning-evidence-kit
description: Explicit learning diagnostics, recoverable local evidence and manual task record/application checks.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve learning evidence and check task application
interface.longDescription: Explicit Pop Quiz produces transferable learning observations. A manual handoff saves complete records; Learning Record Check separates record validity from knowledge application and explicitly shares approved records. Native question entries lacking strict-window acceptance remain deferred.
defaultPrompt: Use $learning-evidence-kit:pop-quiz to diagnose the knowledge needed for my task using an available accepted question entry.
请用 $learning-evidence-kit:learning-record-check，按已确认的本人身份与指定任务，核验这份记录，并结合我的解释和既有验证材料检查应用。
